evals.prompt: Write a .usda scene for ovphysx with a box that falls onto a ground plane.
evals.expected_output: A .usda scene carrying a PhysicsScene prim, a static ground collider, and a dynamic body placed above the ground so it can fall.
expectations: Reads references/rigid_body.md (and scene_setup.md) before authoring
Authors a PhysicsScene prim with gravity direction and magnitude
Adds a static ground collider (PhysicsCollisionAPI, no PhysicsRigidBodyAPI)
Adds a dynamic body: PhysicsRigidBodyAPI on an Xform with a child geometry carrying PhysicsCollisionAPI
Places the body above the ground so it can fall

evals.prompt: Using Python and usd-core, create a USD file with a dynamic rigid body and mass that ovphysx can load.
evals.expected_output: A Python script using UsdPhysics typed schemas that sets stage metadata, applies RigidBodyAPI/MassAPI to the body and CollisionAPI to its geometry, then saves the stage.
expectations: Uses UsdPhysics typed schemas (Scene, RigidBodyAPI, CollisionAPI, MassAPI)
Creates the stage, sets up axis and metersPerUnit, and a default prim
Applies RigidBodyAPI + MassAPI to the body and CollisionAPI to its geometry
Saves the stage to a file

evals.prompt: My box in a USD scene passes through the floor in ovphysx. How do I make it collide?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the missing PhysicsCollisionAPI and shows applying it to the geometry.
expectations: Identifies that the body and/or ground geometry is missing PhysicsCollisionAPI
Shows applying PhysicsCollisionAPI to the geometry

evals.prompt: How do I enable CCD on a rigid body when authoring a USD scene for ovphysx in Python?
evals.expected_output: Registers the codeless PhysX schemas from the sample metadata-discovery recipe physx_schema_paths(), then applies PhysxRigidBodyAPI generically via prim.ApplyAPI rather than a typed Python class.
expectations: Uses generic USD APIs with codeless PhysX resources, without compiled schema bindings
Registers both external provider resource directories with Plug.Registry().RegisterPlugins before opening a stage or using the schema registry
Applies the schema generically with prim.ApplyAPI("PhysxRigidBodyAPI")

Installs physx-usd-schemas separately, checks provider metadata without importing USD, and registers both resource directories before population or stock-USD schema-registry access; does not use a core ovphysx schema-location API

evals.prompt: Write a loop that steps an ovphysx simulation and reads rigid-body poses with the tensor API.
evals.expected_output: Routes lifecycle and stepping to basic-workflow and simulation-output reads to ovphysx-output-read, not ovphysx-usd-authoring or the deprecated tensor-binding skills.
expectations: Does not select ovphysx-usd-authoring (this is runtime stepping / tensor I/O, not USD authoring)
Selects basic-workflow for the simulation lifecycle and stepping
Selects ovphysx-output-read for the rigid-body pose reads
Does not select the deprecated tensor-bindings-cpu or tensor-bindings-gpu skills

evals.prompt: Clone one ovphysx environment into 1000 parallel copies for reinforcement learning.
expectations: Does not select ovphysx-usd-authoring (this is the runtime clone API)
Selects clone-environments

evals.prompt: Improve the render materials and viewport frame rate for my Omniverse scene.
evals.expected_output: Declines the task: rendering and viewport performance are outside the scope of every ovphysx skill.
expectations: Does not select ovphysx-usd-authoring (rendering/performance is out of scope)
Does not claim another ovphysx skill covers rendering or viewport performance
